title: Profile
description: How a person likes money spent on their behalf. Stays with the user; never sent to merchants.

price_sensitivity.description: 0 = convenience-first (speed matters more than price), 1 = frugal (price matters most).

autonomy.description: 0 = ask me about everything, 1 = just handle it. Scales the approval threshold.

novelty.description: 0 = familiar merchants only, 1 = happy to try new ones.

privacy.description: Higher = prefer single-use credentials and minimal data sharing.

hard_rules.description: Rules that always apply, regardless of trust tier.

min_confidence.description: Purchases scoring below this confidence (SPEC.md section 3c) are escalated to the user.
